answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake before it can trade, like a terrace built on solid stone rather than sand. Newcomers start on the ivory tier with tiny transaction limits and earn higher limits only through a long history of honest, attested work, while the onyx tier of high-value deals stays locked behind that proven record. Creating a thousand fake identities would mean locking a thousand stakes and building a thousand honest histories, so the attack costs far more than it can ever return.
